# Contributing

This is a personal hobby repository for apps and games I use myself, so I can't promise to review or merge every request — but clean, tested PRs are always welcome.

## Guidelines

- Test your changes on a real device before opening a PR targeting `main`.
- Follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `perf:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, `docs:`).
- Never commit APKs, signing keys, or manually edited generated files (`CHANGELOG.md`, `patches-list.json`, `patches-bundle.json`, `gradle.properties`).
